enabled_when: raw RLDS spec matches the declared field map
Franka URDF, TCP definition and units are versioned
joint action semantic is selected explicitly

joint_position.raw_semantics: absolute joint target plus absolute gripper target
joint_position.conversion: FK current and target joint configurations, then encode robot-base Cartesian delta

joint_velocity.conversion: requires verified action dt and controller convention; never reinterpret directly as a position target

droid.view_policy: Keep both exterior cameras and wrist camera. Training-time view selection is not part of conversion.

enabled_when: trajectory dictionary keys have been inspected on the downloaded version
TCP pose reference frame, units and rotation representation are known
action semantics have been classified as target, delta or velocity
fmb.action_conversion: Prefer consecutive TCP pose differences only after verifying frame and pose encoding. Keep force, torque, primitive and object metadata as optional streams with masks.

enabled_when: robot, task, embodiment and native bundle version are frozen
joint target semantics are recorded as next_target_joint_position
camera calibration and coordinate convention are preserved
robotwin.raw_container: Native zip bundle containing HDF5 plus instructions/scene/seed sidecars
robotwin.native_action: joint_action/vector is sampled drive-target qpos. Canonical training target is vector[t+1], not velocity or Cartesian delta.
robotwin.camera_handling: Decode NUL-padded JPEG bytes. Preserve intrinsic_cv, extrinsic_cv and cam2world_gl separately; they have different coordinate conventions.
robotwin.timing: No raw timestamp. Record timestamp_source=synthetic_nominal_15hz; do not represent it as hardware synchronization.
robotwin.action_conversion: Cartesian delta requires embodiment-specific URDF, TCP definition and transformed endpose convention. Preserve next_target_joint_position as provenance.
robotwin.arm_mapping: vector order is left_arm, left_gripper, right_arm, right_gripper. Map explicitly for every embodiment.

enabled_when: source format is selected: native HDF5, LeRobot v3 joint, or LeRobot v3 EE
benchmark test tasks and layout seeds are excluded from training
camera transform direction is retained when geometry fields are used
robodojo.raw_container: Official sim/real HDF5 or published LeRobot v2.1/v3.0 exports

available_variants.sim_hdf5: 35 tasks, ARX X5, joint state/action plus richer camera metadata
available_variants.lerobot_v30_joint: 25 Hz, 14D joint target/state and three RGB videos
available_variants.lerobot_v30_ee: 25 Hz, 16D EE pose plus gripper target/state
available_variants.real_hdf5: multiple embodiments and real teleoperation trajectories

robodojo.native_action: Joint export is absolute target [left_6,left_gripper,right_6,right_gripper]. EE export is per arm [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz,gripper].
robodojo.camera_handling: Runtime may call the transform extrinsic_matrix or extrinsics_matrix. Normalize key names but preserve transform_direction; HDF5 decoder color order must be verified before RGB conversion.
robodojo.action_conversion: Use HDF5 or EE export for geometry-aware conversion. Do not invent EE pose or calibration from joint-only LeRobot v3.
robodojo.split_rule: Hold out benchmark task and layout seed combinations; keep sim and real domain labels.
